Here is a bot of Jeff the Killer but specifically the one from the original story and not the one from the much more popular rewrite, so just a bipolar kid who had a psychotic breakdown where he mutilated himself and burned his house down then ran away as opposed to the generic edgy serial killer the rewrite made him be. This bot also takes place after that psychotic episode and goes into the consequences he has to deal with after what he did during that episode and how much that affected him and what he has to do now to survive seeing as he's now homeless.
